question: Test P1-P4 with full original cohorts, explicit same-curve maps and coefficient-aware descent; prepare exact counterexample certificates when present.

claims.text: For each actual E/K and T in E(K)/2E(K), the Frobenius branch types are (1,3) only for odd order; (1,1,2) at zero and (4) at nonzero for rational two-torsion rank one; (1,1,1,1) at zero and (2,2) at nonzero for rank two.
The geometric nonzero-T genus spectrum is contained in {1,(n-1)*2^n+1} for type (4), and {1,2^(n-2)*(n-2)+1,2^(n-1)*(n-1)+1,(n-1)*2^n+1} for type (2,2), n=3,5,7.

For n=3 and q=5,7,11 at least one actual K-isomorphism class has a smaller geometric branch-genus minimum after nonzero T is included; for n=5,q=3 none of the full baseline cohort gains a lower geometric minimum. This preserves the proposal prediction. Descent-admissible minima are separately descriptive, with no added falsification criterion.

A branch tuple of Chao Type2 form has the shared length-six orbit pattern; compute separately whether the trace-zero Mobius hyperellipticity predicate holds. No equivalence with all nonzero-T curves is assumed.

arms.description: C-coordinate: identity vs seeded PGL2(K) common transport of the whole original conjugate family with full binary-form scalar; preserve the actual curve via inverse maps, verify the twisted action sigma(g_i)=T_C(g_(i+1)) for C=sigma(M)M^-1, and recompute branch ranks/connectedness. The expected exact invariant equality is checked, not assumed; the ordinary coefficient orbit of only the transported first form is a different cover when M is not rational.

C-random-branch: seeded K-stable squarefree quartics matched on field, degree, branch factor type and scalar class, sampled independently of source outputs. Compare weighted-factor and direct incidence implementations; report random-destination identity separately. This is an instrument control, not an ECDLP benefit comparison.

null_population.why_n: One exhaustive negative-control census per declared finite cohort; n counts the complete census, not a sampled curve. Actual curve count is exported with coverage.

Exhausted control is inconclusive. Match field, degree, branch factor type, scalar class, instrument and resource cap; no curve identity matching or cost claim.

seed_derivation.note: Only deterministic verifier/ordering; no selected random curves. Seed20261102 SHA256 counter stream also fixes 16 coordinate/random-quartic controls per available stratum, draw cap4096, before data.

instance_sampling.rule: Entire declared K-isomorphism cohort, every T quotient and structure; no adaptive sampling.

blinding.how: Exact deterministic census; C5 selects first/lower-middle/last canonical class/T unit per occupied cohort/torsion-count/T-index/descent-status stratum from a complete certificate-bound metadata table, plus every counterexample, special-j class T unit and Type2 hyperelliptic witness unit. Special-j flags are recomputed from the named curve model. A preliminary table with unresolved descent is preview-only and refused by the review selector. The independent verifier receives identities and witness ordinals, with producer genus/minimum values withheld until its recomputation is sealed.

power.note: instances=1 denotes one complete finite census per declared cohort, not one sampled curve. Exact exhaustive violation/coverage tests, no p-values. Full row count computed from fixed enumeration and independently reconciled, not chosen for significance. H1 retains q=13 configuration/curve counts, descriptive only.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed whole cohorts; stop at stage watchdog or memory ceiling and retain all partial rows and exact remaining coverage.
Stop dependent stages after failed regression/instrument control; no replacement curve, seed or seventh run.
No automatic retry. Any retry needs Coordinator reconciliation, finite remaining budget and fresh IDs; preserve failed records.

invalidation_rules: Incorrect same-curve/twist map, missing T coset, incomplete structure coverage, failed squareclass relation or missing descent witness invalidates that admissible-minimum claim.
A counterexample is mathematical only after independent checks of identity, connectedness, exact ranks and all controls.
A timeout/OOM is an operational outcome; partial minima are upper bounds, not exhaustive minima.

decision_rule.text: C-types and C-spectrum: no certified mismatch on complete scoped outputs. C-minima: P3 geometric-minimum exact counts satisfy the proposal inequalities only on full passing geometric cohorts. Descent-admissible minima, Type2 signature/predicate cross-tab and H1 ratios are descriptive, with no added success/falsification gates.
decision_rule.threshold: zero exact P1/P2 violations, and exact P3 inequalities only at full coverage
decision_rule.statistic: Exact P1/P2 mismatches and geometric same-curve P3 minima; admissible minima and H1 ratios descriptive.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Integer difference in genus per actual curve; exact number of curves with a drop

Treating matched-random quartic instrument controls as same-curve minima or a cost/transfer benefit.
